mult.one: One group of {givenEach}. How many is that?

groups.ask: {givenRows} rows of {givenEach}. How many in all?
groups.row: Each row adds {givenEach}. Count row by row.
groups.last: {partialRows} rows make {partialSum}. One row is left.
groups.addOne: Now add one more row of {givenEach}.

skip-count.askTurn: Turn it around: count by {givenEach}s, {givenTimes} times.
skip-count.onOne: Count on by {givenEach}s, one more time.

known-fact.moreOne: {anchorRows} × {givenEach} is {anchorProduct}. {givenRows} × {givenEach} is one more {givenEach}. What's that?
known-fact.fewerOne: {anchorRows} × {givenEach} is {anchorProduct}. {givenRows} × {givenEach} is one fewer {givenEach}. What's that?
known-fact.on: Count on {partialGroups} more groups of {givenEach} from {anchorProduct}.

nearby-fact.more: {anchorA} × {anchorB} is {anchorProduct}. {givenA} × {givenB} is one more {givenEach}. What's that?
nearby-fact.fewer: {anchorA} × {anchorB} is {anchorProduct}. {givenA} × {givenB} is one fewer {givenEach}. What's that?

share.one: Put all {givenDividend} in one row. How many?
share.deal: Give each row one. Keep going.

array.ask: {givenDividend} dots in rows of {givenDivisor}. How many rows?
array.ten: {anchorRows} rows make {anchorProduct}. Count on the rest.
array.more: {partialSum} so far. How many rows make {givenDividend}?
